state.description: Chart of accounts keyed by AccountID (read-only).
Synthetic invoice e-mail log keyed by InvoiceID/sequence; nothing is delivered.
Sales invoices (ACCREC) and bills (ACCPAY) keyed by InvoiceID; paymentIds is internal.
Row counters (next INV number) and limits (maxScanRows scan bound).
The single connected organisation; tenantId is internal.

operations.description: Read one account by AccountID (GET /Accounts/{AccountID}).
List the chart of accounts (GET /Accounts) with where and order.
Create a contact from name, email and phone (Xero MCP create-contact shape).
Read one contact by ContactID or ContactNumber (GET /Contacts/{ContactID}), including Balances.
List contacts (GET /Contacts): where, order, page, pageSize, IDs, searchTerm, includeArchived, summaryOnly, If-Modified-Since.
Create or update contacts (PUT/POST /Contacts, POST /Contacts/{ContactID}); archive with ContactStatus ARCHIVED.
Update a contact's name, person, e-mail, phone and street address (Xero MCP update-contact shape).
Create a DRAFT invoice or bill (Xero MCP create-invoice shape).
Record a synthetic e-mail of a sales invoice to its contact (POST /Invoices/{InvoiceID}/Email, 204). Nothing is delivered.
Read one invoice by InvoiceID or InvoiceNumber (GET /Invoices/{InvoiceID}).
List sales invoices and bills (GET /Invoices): where, order, page, pageSize, IDs, InvoiceNumbers, ContactIDs, Statuses, searchTerm, summaryOnly, unitdp.
Create or update invoices and bills, including status changes (PUT/POST /Invoices, POST /Invoices/{InvoiceID}).
Update a DRAFT invoice's lines, reference, dates or contact (Xero MCP update-invoice shape).
Read the connected organisation (GET /Organisation). organisationDate is the organisation's local date (virtual time, +12:00).
Apply payments to AUTHORISED invoices and bills (PUT/POST /Payments); updates AmountPaid, AmountDue and PAID status.
Delete a payment with body { Status: "DELETED" } (POST /Payments/{PaymentID}); the invoice returns to AUTHORISED when it was PAID.
Read one payment (GET /Payments/{PaymentID}).
List payments including deleted ones (GET /Payments) with where, order, page and the MCP filters.
Apply one payment to an invoice (Xero MCP create-payment shape).
List tax rates (GET /TaxRates) with where, order and TaxType.

connections.title: Xero MCP tool names (list-invoices, create-invoice, create-payment, ...)
connections.instructions: Connect a Streamable HTTP MCP client to XERO_MCP_URL with XERO_MCP_TOKEN as a Bearer token. Eleven Xero MCP tool names are exposed as aliases with the same argument names; they return JSON entities instead of formatted text.

connections.title: Xero Accounting API 2.0 over HTTP
connections.instructions: Point your Xero client's base path at XERO_BASE_URL followed by /api.xro/2.0 (instead of https://api.xero.com/api.xro/2.0), send XERO_ACCESS_TOKEN as the OAuth 2 Bearer token and send the header xero-tenant-id: 6d1c2f0e-4b8a-4c3e-9a51-2f7e0b9d4c11. Both variable names are a test-side convention; no Xero identity or token endpoint is simulated.
